title: Otter eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water/ground suggestion -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="38" ry="10" fill="#2a7fb8"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="34" ry="8" fill="#3fa0d8"/>
  
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M72 74 Q86 70 84 58 Q83 52 78 54 Q82 64 70 68 Z" fill="#8b5a2b"/>
  <path d="M72 74 Q86 70 84 58 Q83 52 78 54 Q82 64 70 68 Z" fill="none" stroke="#a8723a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="24" ry="18" fill="#a8723a"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="16" ry="12" fill="#e8c898"/>
  
  <!-- back paw -->
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="77" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#8b5a2b"/>
  
  <!-- front paws holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="62" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#a8723a"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="62" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#a8723a"/>
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="62" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#c99a5b"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="62" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#c99a5b"/>
  
  <!-- snack: a fish -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="58" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#f0a030"/>
  <path d="M54 54 L60 50 L58 58 Z" fill="#e08820"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="57" r="1.5" fill="#3a2a10"/>
  <!-- fish shine -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="56" rx="5" ry="1.5" fill="#ffd060" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="17" ry="15" fill="#a8723a"/>
  <!-- face mask / muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="47" rx="11" ry="8" fill="#e8c898"/>
  
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="30" r="5" fill="#8b5a2b"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="30" r="5" fill="#8b5a2b"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="30" r="2.5" fill="#c99a5b"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="30" r="2.5" fill="#c99a5b"/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="40" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#2a1a0a"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="40" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#2a1a0a"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="39" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="39" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="46" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#4a2a10"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="45.5" rx="1.5" ry="1" fill="#6a4020"/>
  
  <!-- mouth / smile -->
  <path d="M46 50 Q50 53 54 50" fill="none" stroke="#6a4020" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1="35" y1="45" x2="26" y2="43" stroke="#c99a5b" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="48" x2="26" y2="49" stroke="#c99a5b" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="65" y1="45" x2="74" y2="43" stroke="#c99a5b" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="65" y1="48" x2="74" y2="49" stroke="#c99a5b" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx="37" cy="47" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#e08070" opacity="0.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="47" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#e08070" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
